def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Remove the isolated 3x3 patch whose only colored cells occupy top two rows.
    # Find connected components of nonzero cells; the target component is a 2x3 rectangle.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                if len(comp)==6 and max(ys)-min(ys)==1 and max(xs)-min(xs)==2:
                    for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=0
    return out
